name: Poisoned Dart (Crew Quarters Trap)
description: A hidden floorboard trap in Compass Rose crew quarters (C6) — portrait of 'Aleitha and Brastos — together forever.'
properties: +5 to hit. Hit: 1 piercing damage + 1d6 poison damage. Target must succeed DC 11 Constitution save or take poison damage.
notes: 200 gp hidden beneath the trapped floorboard.
